args: repo="${SPOTIFY_MCP_REPO:-$HOME/dev/spotify-mcp}"; cd "$repo" 2>/dev/null || { echo "spotify-mcp not found at $repo" >&2; exit 1; }; exec uv run spotify-mcp serve
spotify-mcp.note: Runs the local Python Spotify MCP server. Set SPOTIFY_MCP_REPO to override the default checkout and run 'uv run spotify-mcp auth' once before use.
